NEW SECTION.   Sec. 101.  FINDINGS—INTENT. (1) The legislature 9
finds that, as of 2025:10
(a) Washington's statewide waste recovery rate has been generally 11
static since 2011 and Washington is not meeting the statewide goal of 12
50 percent recycling established in 1989; and 13
(b) Many residents, particularly those who live in rural areas 14
and in multifamily residences, do not have access to convenient or 15
affordable curbside recycling, and must rely on taking recyclables to 16
drop box locations, and that extended producer responsibility 17
programs could make curbside recycling available and affordable for 18
most people in the state. 19
(2)(a) It is the intent of the legislature to require extended 20
producer responsibility programs for consumer packaging and paper 21
